actual: → tonal guide drawn by the agent
→ image2image from the guide (the ONLY reference)
approved_jurnl_pipeline: → image2image Sunburst 4K, full screen (world + UI in one pass)
→ family authority (F02 / F03 / F04 share the world; structure and type differ)
pipeline.why: Every step is locally sensible, but the chain never connects the output to the one input that carries JURNL’s richness — the approved world image. The richness the founder asks for lives in that image; the pipeline only ever passes adjectives and agent-drawn diagrams to the renderer.
